# target_ct bytes extracted from the binary at 0x402060
target_ct = bytes([0xd6, 0x9a, 0x63, 0x24, 0xd1, 0x48, 0xf7, 0x96, 0x3c, 0xd3, 0x5c, 0xfd, 0x6c, 0x0b, 0xa1, 0x2c,
                   0xca, 0x7b, 0x1a, 0xb2, 0x15, 0x9f, 0xe8, 0x22, 0x7b, 0x06])

# The algorithm:
# edx starts at 0xffffff90 (but we only use the lowest byte for XOR)
# For each i:
#   input[i] ^ (edx & 0xff) == target_ct[i]
#   So input[i] = target_ct[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
#   Then edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xffffffff

edx = 0xffffff90

result = []
for i in range(26):
    ch = target_ct[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
    result.append(ch)
    edx = (edx + ch) & 0xffffffff

# Convert to string
flag = ''.join(chr(c) for c in result)
print(f"Computed input: {flag}")
print(f"Bytes: {result}")
